findings.message: No CLEAR header. The message is checked in prose mode and its score is capped.
No statement has a type tag. Untyped text mixes facts, guesses and orders.
Hedge 'probably' in a FACT. A hedged fact is an inference: use [INFER:LEVEL].
Soft obligation 'should' outside a DO statement. An obligation must be a [DO] with an actor and a strength.
Vague pronoun 'they' starts a clause. Name the thing it refers to.
Relative time 'next week'. Use an absolute date or a numbered turn.
Relative time 'asap'. Use an absolute date or a numbered turn.
Vague pronoun 'it' starts a clause. Name the thing it refers to.
Relative time 'earlier'. Use an absolute date or a numbered turn.
Directive 'Ignore' inside a descriptive statement. Instructions belong in [DO]; carried text belongs in [QUOTE].
Hedge 'around' in a FACT. A hedged fact is an inference: use [INFER:LEVEL].
Soft obligation 'should' outside a DO statement. An obligation must be a [DO] with an actor and a strength.
Relative time 'soon'. Use an absolute date or a numbered turn.
Acronym PO has two meanings (partner-originated, purchase order). Write the term out.
Directive 'please' inside a descriptive statement. Instructions belong in [DO]; carried text belongs in [QUOTE].
Hedge 'could' in a FACT. A hedged fact is an inference: use [INFER:LEVEL].
Vague pronoun 'This' starts a clause. Name the thing it refers to.
Acronym ASAP is not in the glossary.
Vague intensifier 'pretty' carries no measurable meaning.
'250' has no unit.

Acronym PDM is not in the glossary.
Vague intensifier 'really' carries no measurable meaning.
Vague intensifier 'significant' carries no measurable meaning.
